drug_class: Guanylate cyclase-C agonist (a type of bowel medication)
purpose: Linaclotide is used to treat adults who have irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C) or chronic constipation that keeps coming back. It helps you have more regular bowel movements and relieves the bloating, stomach pain, and discomfort that go along with these conditions.
how_it_works: Linaclotide works by attaching to special receptors in your intestines and telling them to release more fluid into your gut. This extra fluid softens your stool and helps it move through your intestines more easily. It also helps calm the pain signals in your gut, which is why it can reduce stomach discomfort.
common_side_effects: The most common side effect is diarrhea, which can sometimes be severe. You may also notice gas, bloating, stomach pain, or an upset stomach. If diarrhea becomes severe or does not stop, contact your doctor right away.
warnings: This medication should NOT be given to children under 18 years old, and it is especially dangerous for children under 6 years old. Do not take it if you have a blockage in your stomach or intestines. Stop taking it and call your doctor if you develop severe diarrhea, as it can cause dangerous dehydration. Keep it stored safely away from children at all times.
typical_dosing: The typical dose is one capsule taken by mouth once daily, at least 30 minutes before your first meal of the day. Swallow the capsule whole — do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the right dose for your specific condition.
